name: BL-010 criteria, addendum 3: how Phase 5 chooses
adds_to: bl010_criteria.json, addenda 1 and 2 - unchanged; this file only adds the Phase 5 choice rule
rule: Committed before any Phase 5 window, walk-forward or choice is computed. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Owner's answers, 2026-10-06. Phase 4 found PBO 0.69 on the point-in-time universe (0.53 inside the 40% drawdown ceiling): ranking by CAGR picks luck, so the rank used to choose is fixed here, in advance.

inputs.configs: All 8,003 round 7 arm A configs as re-scored on the point-in-time universe (data/search/round7_A/scored_pit: universe turnover_rank, curated tags, every rebalance phase blended as equal tranches).
inputs.returns: Pre-tax, Rs 2 lakh, itemised costs, as searched. After-tax at Rs 5 lakh is deferred (BL-010 Phase 7); every rebalance interval here is 1 to 4 weeks, so gains are short-term throughout and tax is expected to lower all configs by a similar share. So the minimum bar in bl010_criteria.json (5 points over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI, after tax) is not judged in Phase 5: the pre-tax margin is reported, and the bar is judged on the after-tax re-check of the chosen configs.
inputs.categories: Today's curated tags. Results carry taxonomy hindsight (open question 3) and are reported as an upper estimate until that check is done.
inputs.benchmark: Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI for excess return; Nifty Midcap 150 TRI and Nifty Smallcap 250 TRI for the drawdown baskets.

phase_5.baskets: All three (Conservative, Medium, Aggressive), as defined in bl010_criteria.json; one choice, or 'none', per basket. A config belongs to a basket if criteria.basket_passes holds on its blended weekly curve.

rank_by.measure: 25th percentile of the config's nine financial-year excess returns over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI, FY2018 to FY2026 (April to March; FY2027 to date is reported, not used). Excess = config FY return minus index FY return, in points.
rank_by.plain: Its third-worst financial year against the momentum index.
rank_by.ties: Within 0.5 points: the higher Martin ratio (CAGR over Ulcer index), then the simpler config.

clusters.how: Configs in a basket are grouped by the correlation of their weekly returns: a config joins a cluster when its correlation with the cluster's medoid is at least 0.9.
clusters.score: A cluster is scored by the rank_by measure of its 25th-percentile member; the chosen config is the medoid of the best-scoring cluster, not its best member.

holdings.nominal: category_top_n x picks_per_category, capped by pool_top_n: the most stocks the config can hold at once.
holdings.preference: Prefer 8 to 12 nominal holdings: among clusters whose score is within 1 point of the best, take the one whose medoid holds 8 to 12. A medoid outside 8 to 12 is chosen only if it beats the best 8-to-12 cluster by more than 1 point.
holdings.kill_of_the_preference: If, in the walk-forward, configs with 2 to 6 nominal holdings beat those with 8 to 12 by more than 3 points a year at a similar Ulcer index, the preference is dropped and that is reported.

phase_5.rebalance_every: Any of 1, 2 or 4 weeks; not restricted.

walk_forward.how: For each year Y from FY2019 to FY2026: apply this same rule (basket, rank_by, clusters, holdings) to data ending 13 weeks before Y starts, hold the chosen config through Y, and join the years.
walk_forward.kill: The joined result is not at least 3 points a year above the joined median config of the same basket, or not above Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI.

windows.rolling: Every two-year and three-year window starting each quarter.
windows.pass_for_a_config: In the top half of the whole space (all 8,003) in at least 70% of financial years, and no financial year more than 10 points behind Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI.
windows.kill_top_configs_are_special: The top 100 of a basket beat 100 random configs of the same basket in fewer than 60% of financial years, or their edge comes mostly from FY2024 and FY2025.

factor_check.how: Weekly excess returns regressed on Nifty 50 TRI, a size spread (Smallcap 250 TRI minus Nifty 50 TRI) and a momentum spread (Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI minus Nifty 50 TRI); stationary block bootstrap with 13 to 26 week blocks for CAGR and max drawdown intervals.
factor_check.kill: Alpha below 5% a year or |t| below 2: the result is small-cap momentum exposure, and a momentum index fund is the honest alternative.
